name: Human Rights Studies
description: Available to all interested Yale students, this certificate provides the opportunity to pursue an interdisciplinary study of human rights.
notes: No courses taken Credit/D/Fail may be applied toward the certificate.

Courses taken at another institution or during an approved summer or term-time study abroad program may count with certificate director approval. An on-topic summer internship can replace one elective with approval.
Graduate and professional school courses may count with director approval or if tagged with approved attributes.
Declare on Yale Hub by January 15 or September 15 of the final semester at the latest.

requirements.name: Gateway
requirements.description: Gateway course introducing theoretical tools for studying human rights.

requirements.name: Domestic elective
requirements.description: Elective with YC Human Rights Domestic attribute that substantially engages with human rights language, ideas, and methods.

requirements.name: International elective
requirements.description: Elective with YC Human Rights International attribute that substantially engages with human rights language, ideas, and methods.
